Subject: Re: Onboarding: model shortlist + token estimates (Novalabs)

Laura — thanks for the samples and the clear direction. I reviewed the CSV briefly; good examples. High-level answers below, plus a couple of clarifying questions to make the sizing tighter.

Model shortlist (initial):
1) Mistral-Instruct-8B (cpu/gpu friendly, strong instruction following) — good for classification/rerank short-turns (recommended quantized 4-bit).
2) Llama-3-13B-e (higher quality; use for primary contextual assistant when latency budget allows).
3) Redwood-optimized LLaMA-7B-qat (lower cost variant for burst and lower-priority queries).

Context window guidance:
- 6–8k tokens of retrieved context is reasonable for the use-case you described. For threads with heavy context (code snippets, logs) expect more tokens per session; we should budget for 8k average and 12k for peak.

Initial token-volume assumptions (please confirm):
- Pilot (month 0–1): 2k MAU, average 3 sessions/user/day, avg 420 tokens/session => ~2.52M tokens/day (~75M tokens/month).
- Ramp (month 3): 15k MAU, same session pattern => ~18.9M tokens/day (~567M tokens/month).
- Peak concurrency estimate: assume 2% of MAU concurrent at peak minute => pilot peak qps ~0.7 qps (very low), ramp peak qps ~6 qps.

Questions for you: can you confirm average messages per session and whether you will run long retrieval chains (more than 10 retrieved chunks)? Also, do you plan to embed every user message for retrieval, or only selected queries?

I'll loop in Marissa for throughput/burst sizing recommendations and Monica for the SOW/procurement checklist.

—Karthik
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Onboarding: model shortlist + token estimates (Novalabs)

Adding capacity + ops detail. I took Karthik's numbers and ran a quick throughput sketch (see attached token_profile_estimates.xlsx). Key points and recommendation below.

Summary numbers (rounded):
- Pilot month tokens: 75M/mo => ~2.5M/day, estimated 30M prompt tokens + 45M completion tokens.
- Ramp month tokens (month 3): 567M/mo => ~19M/day, 220M prompt / 347M completion tokens (due to longer responses with context).
- Average tokens/session ~420 assumes ~250 prompt (including retrieval) + ~170 completion. We modeled a 2.3x growth in completion tokens during ramp due to longer assistant outputs when retrieval is enabled.

Throughput/instance guidance:
- For the contextual assistant (Llama-3-13B-e): target p95 latency <= 800ms. Recommend Dedicated pool with 4x A10s equivalent for pilot (handles peaks + warm cache) and scale to 12x A10s equivalent at ramp to keep latency within SLO when cache hit rates drop.
- For short-turn rerank/classification (Mistral-8B quantized): can run on mixed CPU/GPU or smaller GPU profile; 2x A100-equivalents for pilot, 4x at ramp.

Operational recommendations:
- Enable prefix (KV) caching and snippet-level cache for retrieval responses — this will cut token-cost by ~15–25% on stable queries.
- Use 4-bit quantization for Mistral and Redwood-optimized 7B to reduce footprint/costs.
- Set batching windows to 20–40ms for low-latency paths; for non-critical rerank worker pools, use 100–200ms batching to increase throughput.

Attachments: token_profile_estimates.xlsx (contains per-hour token curves, projected p95 qps by hour, and recommended Dedicated counts). Also dropped a draft SOW (sow_draft_v2.pdf) with proposed acceptance criteria and data handling notes.

Next steps (action items):
1) Laura: confirm messages/session and retrieval frequency (answer Karthik's questions).
2) Procurement: review SOW + flag contract items.
3) Redwood: schedule a 30-minute sizing call with Novalabs ops next Tue (I can host).

-Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
